basis: The 2010 paper explicitly evaluates the proposed TS1 mechanism using agreement between calculated and experimental activation enthalpy/energy.
The paper's same-reaction experimental comparison therefore participates in the evidential case for the favored mechanism/method performance.
Selecting MPW1PW91 or another method because it lies closest to the experimental activation values would violate the frozen selection firewall.
All six functional/basis variants remain computational replicates until an independent method-selection rule is fixed without reference to the target kinetics.
